headline: Trump pledges 'tremendous tax' on US firms constructing data centers abroad
summary: US President Donald Trump stated he will prevent American companies from building data centers overseas by imposing steep taxes, aiming to protect domestic AI leadership against China.
why: Hyperscale cloud operators and technology hardware developers are investing hundreds of billions globally in server infrastructure to meet AI compute requirements.

impacts.name: Technology Hardware & Infrastructure
impacts.why: Proposed penalties on offshore facilities would raise global expansion costs and force heavier domestic capital concentration.
